title: Implement an LRU cache
prompt: In lru.js, implement the exported LRUCache class. The constructor takes a capacity (positive integer). get(key) returns the stored value or undefined if not present, and marks the key as most-recently-used. put(key, value) stores/updates the value and marks it as most-recently-used; if inserting a NEW key would exceed capacity, evict the least-recently-used key first. Do not change test.js.
